title: CreateSubscriptionResponse
description: Returned with HTTP 200 in both the success and the validation-failure case. Check for the presence of `errors`.

errors.description: Validation messages, present only when the create failed

id.description: Internal numeric identifier for the subscription

uuid.description: Public identifier for the subscription. Use this value as `subscription_id` in path parameters.

subscription_list_id.description: UUID of the subscription list. Null when the subscription belongs to a dynamic list.

dynamic_list_id.description: Identifier of the dynamic list. Null when the subscription belongs to a subscription list.

subscriber_id.description: Internal numeric identifier of the subscriber

unsubscribed_at.description: When the subscriber opted out of this list. Null while the subscription is active.

delete_at.description: When the subscription is scheduled for deletion
